# `tfctl harness` reference

Manage harness installations and configuration.

## Usage

```shell-session
$ tfctl harness <subcommand> [options]
```

## Description

The `tfctl harness` command provides subcommands for managing harness installations. Use these commands to install harness components and display harness context information.

## Subcommands

- [`context`](/terraform/tfctl-cli/reference/cli/harness/context) - Display harness context information
- [`install`](/terraform/tfctl-cli/reference/cli/harness/install) - Install harness components

## Examples

The following command displays harness context:

```shell-session
$ tfctl harness context
```

The following command installs harness components:

```shell-session
$ tfctl harness install
```

## Global flags

Refer to [Global flags reference](/terraform/tfctl-cli/reference/cli#global-flags) for information about flags you can use with all commands.
